Lokho ezikudingayo

Ukuhumushwa kokunakekelwa kwezilwane kuyimibhalo engakabuyekezwa. Amanothi okunakekela esiNgisi ayatholakala ngezansi. Eminye imininingwane yezilwane isengaba ngesiNgisi.

Izinkukhu zenyama ezigcinwa phansi endlini: kungabi ngaphezu kuka-40 kg wesisindo sezinkukhu ngemitha eyisikwele ngayinye.
Inothi lokuqala lokunakekela izilwane

Floor-housed broilers: no more than 40 kg of bird per square metre.

Amatshwele asanda kuchanyuselwa kufanele anikwe ukudla engakapheli amahora angu-24 echanyuselwe.
Inothi lokuqala lokunakekela izilwane

Newly hatched chicks must be given feed within 24 hours of hatching.

Amatshwele asanda kuchanyuselwa kufanele akwazi ukuthola amanzi engakapheli amahora angu-24 echanyuselwe, futhi ngokushesha kakhulu uma kushisa.
Inothi lokuqala lokunakekela izilwane

Newly hatched chicks must be given access to water within 24 hours of hatching, sooner in hot weather.

Amanzi ahlanzekile nokudla okufanele kuhlale kutholakala, ukuze izinkukhu zingalambi futhi zingomi.
Inothi lokuqala lokunakekela izilwane

Fresh water and the right feed always available, so birds are free from hunger and thirst.

Izindlu zezinkukhu zenyama zidinga ukungena nokugeleza komoya okungenani okungamamitha ayi-cubic angu-5 ngehora ngekhilogremu ngayinye yesisindo sezinkukhu ezisendlini.
Inothi lokuqala lokunakekela izilwane

Broiler houses need a minimum ventilation/airflow rate of 5 cubic metres per hour for every kilogram of bird mass in the house.

Ekufuyeni izinkukhu zenyama ezihamba ngaphandle, inani eligcinwa ngaphakathi akufanele lidlule izinkukhu ezingu-15 ngemitha eyisikwele yendawo yaphansi.
Inothi lokuqala lokunakekela izilwane

In free-range broiler production, indoor stocking must not exceed 15 birds per square metre of floor space.

The law
An owner or manager whose animals are, or may be, infected with a controlled animal disease must report it to the state veterinary director immediately.
Newcastle disease and notifiable avian influenza are on the state list of controlled and notifiable animal diseases.
No animal may be slaughtered anywhere but an abattoir, with the exceptions below.
Slaughter for your own household, or for cultural or religious purposes, is exempt from the abattoir rule.

Seo di se hlokang

Diphetolelo tsa tlhokomelo ya diphoofolo ke meralo e eso hlahlojwe. Dinoto tsa tlhokomelo tsa Senyesemane di fumaneha ka tlase. Dintlha tse ding tsa diphoofolo di ka nna tsa ba ka Senyesemane.

Dikgoho tsa nama tse dulang fatshe ka tlung: boima ba dikgoho bo se ke ba feta 40 kg ka mithara ya sekwere.

Floor-housed broilers: no more than 40 kg of bird per square metre.

Leswi swi swi lavaka

Vuhundzuluxeri bya nhlayiseko wa swifuwo i tindzimana leti nga si kamberiwaka. Tinotsi ta nhlayiseko ta Xinghezi ta kumeka laha hansi. Vuxokoxoko byin’wana bya swifuwo byi nga ha va hi Xinghezi.

Tihuku ta nyama leti tshamaka ehansi endlwini: ku nga vi ni ntiko wa tihuku wo hundza 40 kg hi mitara ya xikwere.
Notsi yo sungula ya nhlayiseko wa swifuwo

Floor-housed broilers: no more than 40 kg of bird per square metre.

Newly hatched chicks must be given feed within 24 hours of hatching.

Swiciwana leswi nga ha ku tlhotlhoriwaka swi fanele ku kota ku kuma mati ku nga si hundza 24 wa tiawara endzhaku ka ku tlhotlhoriwa, hi ku hatlisa ku tlurisa loko ku hisa.
Notsi yo sungula ya nhlayiseko wa swifuwo

Newly hatched chicks must be given access to water within 24 hours of hatching, sooner in hot weather.

Mati yo tenga ni swakudya leswi faneleke swi fanele ku va kona minkarhi hinkwayo, leswaku tihuku ti nga vi ni ndlala ni torha.
Notsi yo sungula ya nhlayiseko wa swifuwo

Fresh water and the right feed always available, so birds are free from hunger and thirst.

Tindlu ta tihuku ta nyama ti lava mpimo wa ku nghena ni ku famba ka moya wa kwalomu ka 5 wa timitara ta khubiki hi awara eka khilogiramu yin’wana ni yin’wana ya ntiko wa tihuku leti nga endlwini.
Notsi yo sungula ya nhlayiseko wa swifuwo

Broiler houses need a minimum ventilation/airflow rate of 5 cubic metres per hour for every kilogram of bird mass in the house.

Eka ku fuwa tihuku ta nyama leti fambafambaka ehandle, nhlayo leyi tshamaka endzeni a yi fanelanga ku hundza 15 wa tihuku hi mitara ya xikwere ya ndhawu ya le hansi.
